verdict.rationale: Marqeta offers an MCP server for agents to query API data and act on it (card issuance, spend controls), but there is no evidence of AI-generated insights, analytics, or suggestions surfaced to users inside the product itself — it's raw data querying, not insight generation. Missing for 10: any dashboard, report, or in-product AI feature that analyzes user data and proactively surfaces insights/recommendations.
